notes.title: 《KunlunWonderland》Released
notes.content:
Although the distance is still far from addictive, the existing content is indeed playable. (Not very confident)
Next, we will make some bug fixes and supplements to the existing multiplayer shooting gameplay, and complete the small battlefield mode. Then invest in the development of the editor. It's really difficult for me to make a map alone. I don't have much talent.


There will be more and more features and gameplay in the future.
